The '''husband''' of [[Elise Montagne]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned a [[GE3-series protocol droid]] named [[C8-42-GE3]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. When Elise's husband [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], she fell into a depression and began treating C8-42-GE3 as her dead husband, leading him to run away.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic" />
